name: The Briar Colossus
_doc: The ZONE BOSS example (a world event out in the wilds, many players). Falling rocks that stay where they land and give cover from a line-of-sight roar; spread circles on everyone; a soak that punishes the whole arena if nobody stands in it; sap pools that heal the boss if it stands in one; a third phase on a NEW health bar where it roots itself behind a shield until its seedlings die; soft enrage from 4 minutes, hard at 6.

say.pull: The ground heaves. Something vast uncurls from the thicket.
say.death: The Colossus collapses into a tangle of dead wood.
say.reset: The briars close over the clearing again.

enrage.say: The Colossus tears itself loose — RUN!

soft.say: The thorns grow longer with every heartbeat.

rockfall.name: Rockfall
rockfall.say: Stones break loose from the canopy!

roar.name: Withering Roar
roar.say: The Colossus fills its lungs — hide behind the stones!

seedburst.name: Seed Burst
seedburst.say: Seeds cling to everyone — spread out!

taproot.name: Taproot
taproot.say: A root rises — someone stand on it!

telegraphs.failSay: Nobody held the root — the ground erupts!

bramble_nova.name: Bramble Nova
bramble_nova.say: Thorns everywhere — find the clear ground!

phases.name: Thrashing
phases.say: The Colossus thrashes, ripping up the earth!

phases.name: Rooted
phases.say: It sinks its roots and raises a wall of bark!

do.say: Both great stones are rubble — nowhere left to hide from the roar!
